upgrade.context: complete original provider and consumer files, target interface, three public smoke cases; identical task semantics in both languages
upgrade.execution_envelope: pure scalar functions; sealed memfd native executable; CPU 2 seconds, address space 256 MiB, wall timeout 5 seconds per validation
upgrade.failure_policy: retain every raw response and failure; no human output rewriting or added attempts
upgrade.grammar: JSON object syntax only; no answer-specific decoder constraint
upgrade.hidden_generation: fixed boundary cross-products plus 64 deterministic LCG triples per task, seed 539365416, duplicate and public cases removed
upgrade.hidden_validation: once after the first public-pass candidate; hidden failures never create a second submission or reach the model
upgrade.models: the same two frozen model families, in the same execution order as the primary experiment
upgrade.native_controls: old and fully upgraded programs execute against the independent oracle; provider-only and consumer-only migrations must fail actual verification or compilation
upgrade.repair_feedback: compiler or Core-verification diagnostic plus three public smoke cases only; unchanged token budget on the second submission
upgrade.response: strict JSON files mapping with both complete replacements; actual patch.v2 interface_policy=migrate for HIA, actual api.rs/client.rs compilation for Rust
upgrade.role: separate secondary two-file interface migration pilot; does not replace or inflate the primary four-task gate
upgrade.scope: two finite interface changes; no general project upgrade productivity, external-caller or human-labor claim
